office_does: A KPUD commissioner sits on the three-member elected board that sets budgets and rates for Kitsap's public water, wastewater and fiber utility, for a six-year term; every county voter votes on each seat in November.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Stacey Smith, appointed to the South Kitsap seat in 2025, is the only candidate. The same ballot carries KPUD Proposition 1 on electric authority, which her board placed there.

candidates.summary: KPUD commissioner for South Kitsap since a 2025 appointment and Kitsap County's Director of Aging and Long-Term Care; a licensed counselor. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed KPUD commissioner in 2025; seeking the full six-year term [S1][S2][S3]
Priorities: fair public utility rates, broadband expansion, clean water and wastewater support [S1][S3]
Signed, as board secretary, the resolution placing KPUD Proposition 1 on the ballot; no personal position on it found [S4]
